title: Design System: St Marys Village Dry Cleaners

display.purpose: Hero h1 only; weight 700, with a weight-500 champagne emphasis line.

headline.purpose: Every section's .section-title; contact-intro h2 is a heavier uppercase variant.

title.purpose: Component headings: service-tile h3, process-step h3, footer-name.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, service-tag, brand-name/brand-sub, stat-label, footer column headers.

shadows.name: shadow-dark
shadows.purpose: Fixed-call affordance and the lightbox image.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for nearly all transitions.

motion.name: reveal-on-scroll
motion.purpose: Section content fade/rise on first scroll into view; collapses instantly under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: hero-parallax
motion.value: translate(relX*-14px, relY*-10px) on hero mousemove, via requestAnimationFrame
motion.purpose: Subtle hero-content drift; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: tile-tilt
motion.purpose: Lightweight 3D tilt on service tiles; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: call-pulse
motion.purpose: Keeps the fixed Call affordance alive; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: scroll-cue-drop
motion.purpose: Hero scroll-cue dot; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Charcoal-filled pill CTA used on both light and dark backgrounds.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5em; padding: 1.05em 2.1em; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.92rem; min-height: 48px; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), box-shadow 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary { background: #171918; color: #F5F2EA; box-shadow: 0 20px 44px -24px rgba(23,25,24,0.22); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #050605; box-shadow: 0 34px 80px -30px rgba(23,25,24,0.3); }

components.name: Outline Light Button
components.description: Transparent, translucent-ivory-bordered CTA for dark backgrounds (hero, contact-intro-panel).
components.css: .ds-btn-outline-light { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 1.05em 2.1em; border-radius: 999px; min-height: 48px; background: transparent; color: #F5F2EA; border: 1px solid rgba(245,242,234,0.4); transition: background-color 0.35s, border-color 0.35s; } .ds-btn-outline-light:hover { background: rgba(245,242,234,0.1); border-color: rgba(245,242,234,0.7); }

components.name: Service Mosaic Tile
components.description: Nearly-square (--r-img: 2px) photo tile with a bottom gradient scrim, caption text overlaid directly on the photo, and a JS 3D-tilt hover effect. Part of a fixed-height flex row-group, never a CSS Grid span.

components.css: .ds-service-tile { position: relative; flex: 1; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 2px; display: block; } .ds-service-tile img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-service-tile:hover img { transform: scale(1.07); } .ds-service-tile-scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(23,25,24,0.78) 0%, rgba(23,25,24,0.1) 55%, transparent 75%); } .ds-service-tile-caption { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; padding: 1.6rem; color: #F5F2EA; } .ds-service-tag { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #C7AD85; }

components.description: Ultra-minimal step: small line icon, outlined/transparent-fill serif numeral, and one uppercase word — no paragraph copy.

components.name: Why Choose Us Stat
components.description: Large Playfair Display numeral/value paired with a tiny uppercase muted label, divided by a hairline vertical rule — a minimal statistics row, not prose or an icon-card block.
components.css: .ds-stat { flex: 1; padding: 0 1.2rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; border-left: 1px solid rgba(245,242,234,0.14); } .ds-stat-num { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 3.6vw, 2.9rem); color: #C7AD85; line-height: 1; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(245,242,234,0.66); }

narrative.overview: This system fully replaces "The Linen Press" (forest green/cream/peach/sage/coral/butter, DM Serif Display + Manrope, a 12-section alternating-hue editorial stack). Nothing from that palette, type pairing, or component set carries forward. The new world reads as a minimalist, visual-first boutique identity -- closer to an Apple/Aesop/luxury-fashion-editorial brochure than a warm multi-hue magazine spread: a restrained ivory/stone/charcoal/champagne palette, a single full-bleed hero video, and large photography doing almost all of the persuasion work, with short, quiet copy rather than paragraphs of trust-building prose. The page is a 7-section stack (hero, services, process, why-choose-us, gallery, contact, footer). The previous system's standalone Reviews section and FAQ accordion are both gone; their facts were folded into Why Choose Us's stat row and the Contact split screen.
keyCharacteristics: A quiet three-register rhythm (ivory -> white -> charcoal -> ivory -> white) rather than the superseded system's six-hue page-turn pacing
A deliberate radius contrast: photography is nearly square (--r-img: 2px) while every button, pill, and the floating navbar are fully rounded (--r-pill: 999px) -- never mixed
Services and Gallery both use independent fixed-height flex row-groups (not CSS Grid spanning) to build an asymmetric editorial mosaic without empty-cell risk
Playfair Display used across its real weight range (400-700 plus italic) paired with Inter -- weight itself carries hierarchy, unlike the superseded system's bold-free serif
All JS-driven motion (hero mouse-parallax, 3D tile tilt, scroll-reveal, call-pulse, scroll-cue) is gated behind prefers-reduced-motion in both CSS and js/main.js

rules.name: The Single-Accent Rule
rules.body: Champagne/champagne-deep are the system's only warm color; every other surface is ivory, white, stone, or charcoal. There is no second accent hue -- restraint is the point of a quiet-luxury palette, not an oversight.

rules.name: The Radius Contrast Rule
rules.body: Two radius vocabularies are used, deliberately never mixed: --r-img (2px, nearly square) on every photographic surface, and --r-pill (999px, fully rounded) on every button, the floating navbar, the header-cta, the fixed-call affordance, and the scroll-cue. No surface uses a mid-range radius.

rules.name: The Fixed-Row-Group Mosaic Rule
rules.body: Asymmetric tile variety in Services and Gallery is built from a vertical stack of independent flex rows, each with its own explicit clamp() height, never a single CSS Grid with grid-column/grid-row spans -- avoiding the empty-cell/whitespace bug class that auto-sized Grid row-spanning caused earlier in this project's history.

dos: Do use --r-img (2px) for every photographic surface and --r-pill for every control; never introduce a mid-range (8-16px) card radius (The Radius Contrast Rule).
Do build mosaic/asymmetric layouts from independently fixed-height flex row-groups, never CSS Grid with grid-column/grid-row spans (The Fixed-Row-Group Mosaic Rule).
Do gate every JS-driven motion effect behind prefers-reduced-motion, matching both the CSS media query and the js/main.js reduceMotion flag.
Do keep the nav to exactly Services / Our Care / Contact plus one Call Now pill.
Do keep every interactive control at a 48x48px minimum touch target.
Do use real line-art SVG icons, never a glyph/icon font.
donts: Don't carry over any token, color, or component from the superseded "Linen Press" system; this is a full replacement, not a merge.
Don't achieve service-tile or gallery-tile visual variety via grid-column/grid-row spanning; use fixed row-groups with varied flex ratios instead.
Don't add a booking/scheduling form to Contact; the business is walk-in/drive-up only (see PRODUCT.md).
Don't invent review content, star counts, pricing, or years-in-business figures; show only the sourced TrueLocal aggregate, linked out.
notCanonized: Four .eyebrow kicker labels (above 'What We Care For', 'From Drop-Off to Collection', 'Garment Care, Up Close', and 'Visit Us') are present in the shipped markup. Kickers/eyebrows are a banned device, and the predecessor system explicitly rejected the same device in its own finish review. This is recorded as a defect the build currently carries, not as a DESIGN.md rule or component -- it should be removed from the markup, not re-legitimized by documentation.
